Paul is back with a Peer-2-Peer update!
The Peer-to-Peer update is now live!

ONLINE: Gameplay is good, but mandatory online connection and unstable servers make the game hard to recommend.
Player never reached the main menu, getting network errors despite troubleshooting DNS, firewall, and reinstalling.
CONTENT: Player asks where crime.net, the preplanning phase, and their weapons went, and where the servers are.
Buyer says the game differs from pre-order expectations and barely improved in two years.
DESIGN: Fun after learning the right skills, but will change to positive once the game is fixed.
Reviewer advises against buying now: music and guns are good, but grinding and leveling are poor.
STAB: Game crashes after one heist from an engine bug; reviewer suggests waiting for a sale.
Reviewer requested a refund because the game would not run at all.
MONET: Developer's statement signals reduced investment in year two, which the reviewer sees as greed by the studio.
Gold Edition price fell sharply after launch with no pre-order compensation; reviewer calls it fraud.
